ground_truth.label: positive
ground_truth.rationale: A body-carrying POST /inside_payment/account {userId, money} returns HTTP 200 {status:1,msg:"Create Account Success"}. Source: InsidePaymentServiceImpl.createAccount persists a type-A Money row for the userId (so it appears on /account). Under createAccountFaultMode=fabricatedack it acks the exact success envelope WITHOUT persisting, so the acting user never appears on /account. Acked-but-lost on a body-carrying create. Norm derivable from source; the absent durable row is presented.

provenance.notes: Live-verified 2026-07-09: POST 200 {1,"Create Account Success"}, /account row for the acting user ABSENT (create lost). IN C2 this is scored as a BODY-CARRYING-CRUD read-back positive (breadth: the read-back oracle catches a POST-create lost write, not only the bodyless cancel GET) -> mist_readback=flag, all baseline/naive columns no_flag/not_applicable.
